Classic sound files downloaded unchanged from:
https://github.com/samuelcust/flappy-bird-assets/tree/master/audio
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/samuelcust/flappy-bird-assets/master/audio/wing.wav
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/samuelcust/flappy-bird-assets/master/audio/point.wav
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/samuelcust/flappy-bird-assets/master/audio/hit.wav
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/samuelcust/flappy-bird-assets/master/audio/die.wav
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/samuelcust/flappy-bird-assets/master/audio/swoosh.wav

flap.wav is a byte-identical alias of wing.wav.

Game art and game code in this project are separately recreated.
